# Our Youth 4 The Climate (OY4C)

> Our Youth 4 The Climate (OY4C) is a global, youth-led non-profit that builds and scales free, high-quality climate change education for the next generation. Its volunteers design and deliver interdisciplinary, action-driven climate lessons in classrooms across six continents.

OY4C is a fiscally hosted project of a company registered in England and Wales. The website is a client-rendered React application; it collects no personal data directly, uses no analytics or advertising trackers, and sets no cookies of its own.

## Key facts
- Mission: make climate change education accessible, high-quality and youth-led.
- Reach: 133 volunteers, 43 countries, ~10,000 students reached (2025 figures).
- Everything OY4C offers to schools and young people is free.
- Programmes: the OY4CCurriculum (ready-to-teach curriculum) and CCiC (Climate Curriculum into Classrooms workshops, now an open resource).

## Main pages
- [Home](https://oy4c.org/): overview of OY4C, impact and programmes.
- [About](https://oy4c.org/about): who OY4C is and its mission.
- [OY4CCurriculum](https://oy4c.org/curriculum): free, youth-developed climate curriculum for schools.
- [CCiC](https://oy4c.org/ccic): Climate Curriculum into Classrooms workshop programme and open resource kit.
- [Ambassador Programme](https://oy4c.org/ambassador): the OY4C ambassador network.
- [Impact](https://oy4c.org/impact): impact figures and the 2025 Impact Report.
- [Team](https://oy4c.org/team): the global volunteer team.
- [Advisory Board](https://oy4c.org/advisory-board): advisors supporting OY4C.
- [Partnerships](https://oy4c.org/partnerships): partner organisations.
- [Blog](https://oy4c.org/blog): articles on climate education and OY4C news.
- [Contact](https://oy4c.org/contact): who to contact, by topic.

## Get involved
- Bring OY4C to a school or run a CCiC workshop: email hello@oy4c.org
- Donations: https://validaid.org/fundraiser/174
